title: Shopify Store Catalog & Pricing Extractor Input
description: Scrape one or many Shopify storefronts: full catalog, collection, single product, in-store search, or the collection directory.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to scrape. `catalog` walks the public product feed, `collection` walks specific collections, `product` fetches exact product handles, `search` uses the storefront search suggestions, `collections` lists collection metadata, and `auto` detects the type of each URL in `startUrls`.

storeUrls.title: Shopify store URLs
storeUrls.description: Store domains or URLs, e.g. `deathwishcoffee.com` or `https://www.allbirds.com`. Accepts custom domains and `*.myshopify.com`. A product or collection URL is reduced to its store for catalog/collections/search modes.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (mixed, optional)
startUrls.description: Store, collection or product URLs. In `auto` mode each URL selects its own job: `/products/<handle>` fetches one product, `/collections/<handle>` fetches a collection, any other store URL fetches the catalog. In the other modes these URLs add stores and, for collection/product modes, their handles.

collectionHandles.title: Collection handles (mode=collection)
collectionHandles.description: Collection handles or collection URLs, e.g. `new-arrivals`, `sale`, or `https://store.com/collections/sale`. Handles are applied to every store in `storeUrls`; a full collection URL is applied to its own store.

productHandles.title: Product handles (mode=product)
productHandles.description: Product handles or product URLs, e.g. `dark-roast-coffee` or `https://store.com/products/dark-roast-coffee`. Handles are applied to every store in `storeUrls`; a full product URL is applied to its own store.

searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)
searchQuery.description: In-store search term. Shopify's public suggest endpoint returns at most 10 products per store and has no pagination.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code to pin prices to, e.g. `USD`, `EUR`, `GBP`. Use `store` to use the store's base currency from `/meta.json`. Pinning is important because Shopify localizes prices by IP.

country.title: Country (optional)
country.description: Two-letter ISO country code passed as `?country=` to the storefront, e.g. `US`, `GB`, `DE`.

vendor.title: Vendor contains
vendor.description: Keep products whose vendor contains this text (case-insensitive).

productType.title: Product type contains
productType.description: Keep products whose product type contains this text (case-insensitive).

tag.title: Tag contains
tag.description: Keep products with at least one tag containing this text (case-insensitive).

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: Drop products whose lowest variant price is below this value.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Drop products whose lowest variant price is above this value.

available.title: Availability
available.description: Keep all products, only products with at least one purchasable variant, or only sold-out products.

maxItems.title: Max records
maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows across all stores. When `flattenVariants` is on, each variant row counts as one.

maxPages.title: Max pages per feed
maxPages.description: Page cap per product/collection feed. Each page holds up to 250 items and Shopify refuses offsets above 25,000, so the effective maximum is 100.

includeDetails.title: Include barcode, weight and inventory
includeDetails.description: Fetch `/products/{handle}.json` for each emitted product to add barcode, weight/grams and inventory fields. Costs one extra request per product and is off by default. Product mode always uses the detail endpoint.

flattenVariants.title: One row per variant
flattenVariants.description: Emit one `recordType: variant` row per variant instead of one product row with nested variants. Variant and product IDs are de-duplicated.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (optional)
proxyConfiguration.description: Leave empty to fetch directly. After a 403 or 429 block the actor retries through Apify's datacenter proxy (AUTO) automatically. If you set this, your configuration is used for that retry instead of AUTO; direct requests are still tried first.
